name: @animalabs/connectome-host
description: Recipe-configured host for long-lived agents on the Connectome stack: TUI, headless daemon, fleets, and a web operator console

scripts.version: bun scripts/release-changelog.ts && git add CHANGELOG.md changelog.d
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.build:web:ci: npm ci --prefix web && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.relock:web: rm -rf web/node_modules web/package-lock.json && npm --prefix web install
scripts.postinstall: test ! -d web || { npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix web run build; } || echo 'connectome-host: the optional Web UI build failed (npm --prefix web install, then run build). The host can run without the Web UI. Retry with: npm run build:web' >&2
